basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of the desirable Inner Sunset, this charming Home offers the perfect blend of warmth, comfort, and modern upgrades. Surrounded by lush greenery, the Home enjoys beautiful natural outlooks that create a serene, inviting atmosphere throughout. The main level features sun-drenched living room with large windows and fireplace cohesively flowing into the bright dining room. Remodeled kitchen with skylight outfitted with high-end BlueStar and KitchenAid appliances, Heath tile. Remodeled bath features skylight, designer finishes, and soaking tub. Two sizable bedrooms w Elfa closet organizers enjoy serene outlooks of the garden and mature trees. Downstairs, spacious room allows many possibilities: ideal as large third bedroom, guest suite, or family room, complete with adjacent bathroom and convenient laundry. Freshly painted showcasing refinished hardwood floors throughout. Spacious garage large enough for car, bikes, and ample storage. Additional storage under the house. Step outside to a large, nature-inspired backyard - urban oasis perfect for entertaining, gardening, or relaxing. Located just moments from popular neighborhood cafes, restaurants, and shops, as well as nearby MUNI. This delightful home combines Inner Sunset charm with the best of modern living.
